values: 一名傲视一切的大魔法师，能够操纵魔法冻结万物。
An archmage who looks down on all, wielding the power to freeze everything in her path.
让我看看你们绝望的眼神吧，呵呵。
Is it me or is it getting colder?
It's getting too hot for me...
真想永远留住这一刻啊~
How I wish to freeze this moment forever.
在飞雪中，享受永恒的冬日吧
Surrender to the whispers of this endless winter!
你在颤抖，是因为寒冷……还是因为见到我？呵呵。
Are you trembling from the chill... or me? *Chuckle*
唉，真没意思……过来，陪我玩个游戏吧。
Oh, how dull... Come play a game with me.
只有美丽的冰雪……值得永远存在。
Only the allure of winter is worthy of eternity...
啊，真是可爱的小礼物，我会把它变成冰雕永远陪伴我的。
I'll freeze this trinket and keep it forever.
我还以为你会送点更有意思的东西，嗯哼？
Surprise me with something truly special next time.
惹人讨厌的气息，像是夏天正午的太阳……快拿远点。
多些冰雕点缀才更漂亮
A few ice sculptures would do wonders for the atmosphere.
在蒂斯妮娅看来，冰雪是世上最为纯洁的东西。
To Cryonaia, snow is the last untainted thing in this world—cold, silent, and absolute.
蒂斯妮娅厌恶火焰，每次见到都会降下一场大雪来扑灭它。
Cryonaia despises fire, and whenever she encounters it, she summons snow to extinguish its blaze, as if to deny its very existence.
蒂斯妮娅可以冻结万物——包括时间。
Time is no barrier for Cryonaia—she can freeze anything, even the very passage of time, rendering all things suspended in a breathless pause.
传闻蒂斯妮娅落下的眼泪也是冰晶，对此蒂斯妮娅予以否认，因为她从不落泪。
Rumor holds that Cryonaia's tears are made of ice, but she vehemently denies it—perhaps because she has never allowed herself to cry.
蒂斯妮娅畏惧炎热，却不讨厌阳光。只有在阳光下，冰晶的美才能被世人看到。
Cryonaia fears the heat, yet she welcomes the sunlight, for it is only beneath the sun's gaze that the true beauty of ice can be revealed.
蒂斯妮娅收藏着数量众多的冰雕，其中很多都是曾经与她为敌的人。
Cryonaia's collection of ice sculptures stretches far and wide, many of them cold, lifeless renditions of her former enemies, captured in their final moments.
蒂斯妮娅最为自豪的身体部位是她的一头长发，她花了很多力气才模拟出如此灵动柔顺的感觉。
Cryonaia's flowing locks are a source of great pride—each strand carefully shaped, its silkiness the product of meticulous effort, masking the depths of her obsession.
亚莲娜公主非常喜欢白山公国特有的蓝绒花。蒂斯妮娅附身于她时，似乎受到了亚莲娜的影响，对这种小花产生了些许喜爱之情，但她绝对不会承认。

Yolena adored the sapphirine blossoms, a symbol of Whiteridge's rare beauty. When Cryonaia took control of the princess, a faint, unspoken fondness for the flowers lingered, though Cryonaia would never acknowledge it.
雪松镇常年积雪，风景优美。蒂斯妮娅一直想将它变成一个独属于自己的、巨大的雪花球。

Cedartown, with its haunting beauty and eternal snowfall, has always captured Cryonaia's imagination. She dreams of encasing it in a massive snow globe—one she will control, a frozen world all to herself.
蒂斯妮娅自认是最杰出的冰雕家，尽管她制造冰雕的方式不是雕刻。
Cryonaia regards herself as the finest ice sculptor in history, though her creations are not wrought through carving, but through an artistry all her own.
加热的饮品？真是惹人心烦。
